Payroll run — 2026-11
3 people, 12,100.00 gross, payday 2026-11-30 — drafted, not paid

## Lines
| Name | Role | Gross | Payday | Draft |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dana Kim | Engineer | 5,200.00 | 2026-11-30 | posted |
| Omar Haddad | Designer | 4,500.00 | 2026-11-30 | posted |
| Priya Nair | Support (started 2026-11-16) | 2,400.00 | 2026-11-30 | posted |

## Total
- 12,100.00 gross across 3 people; October was 9,400.00 across 2.

## Changes since last month
- Starter: Priya Nair, 4,800.00 monthly, 11 of 22 working days = 2,400.00.
- Pay change: Omar Haddad 4,200.00 → 4,500.00 (Team document, "from November").

## Check before paying
- Priya's pro-rata (11/22 days) and start date.
- Omar's rise is in the Team document; confirm it was agreed from November.

script.say:
